channel.title: Chew On This
channel.description: Chew On This — bite-sized health facts worth chewing on. Each episode, Alex and Jordan dig into the surprising science behind food, exercise, and your body: why your gut microbes decide how many calories you actually absorb, what protein really does, and which health "rules" are total myths. No lectures, no fad diets — just the fascinating stuff, served in minutes.

item.title: Leftover Pasta Is Healthier (Seriously): The Science of Resistant Starch
item.description: Alex and Jordan explain carb retrogradation: why cooling rice, pasta, and potatoes creates resistant starch, lowers the blood sugar spike, feeds your gut bacteria — and why reheating doesn't undo it. Plus the overnight test you can try tonight.

item.title: Are All Calories Really the Same?
item.description: Alex and Jordan dig into why a calorie is and isn't just a calorie: digestion costs, hunger hormones, the Twinkie diet experiment, why alcohol pauses fat burning, and what your gut microbes have to do with it.
